title: Independent audit of the fixed ten-CA live Helius smoke
objective: Independently verify that the ten-CA live smoke used exactly the addresses frozen in SOL-HELIUS-MANUAL-CA-BATCH-LIVE-SMOKE-001; all passed strict 32-byte Base58 validation before Helius source creation; execution stayed Solana-only, Helius-only, read-only, manually triggered, bounded to at most three requests per CA and fail-closed; the committed report contains only scrubbed per-CA evidence; and the PARK verdict accurately states that no complete Helius result was obtained because only the allowlisted helius_transport_unavailable warning remained.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Helius, GMGN or any network provider during the audit.
Do not inspect, print, save or record any credential, credential-bearing URL, raw provider payload, arbitrary provider text, full exception text or ignored Harness logs.
Do not modify runtime source, tests, provider scope, chain activation, automation, persistence, cache, queue, production infrastructure or the smoke report.
Do not upgrade a PARK live result to a successful data-completeness claim.
